payload.name: Rename PatchPilot to RiskRadar
payload.description:
please update the entire project name into "RiskRadar" instead "PatchPilot" and update the readme structure and ui components.

Scope of work:
1. Rename all package names from `@patchpilot/*` to `@riskradar/*` (core, web, worker, mcp, cli) and update all workspace cross-references and root package.json scripts
2. Rename all source code references:
   - Class names: `PatchPilotService` → `RiskRadarService`, `PatchPilotError` → `RiskRadarError`
   - Service/cookie names: `patchpilot-worker` → `riskradar-worker`, `patchpilot-watch` → `riskradar-watch`
   - Data directory: `.patchpilot/` → `.riskradar/`
   - Default data file: `patchpilot.db.json` → `riskradar.db.json`
3. Rename all environment variables: `PATCHPILOT_*` → `RISKRADAR_*`
4. Rename UI strings/components: brand name on landing page, dashboard nav, meta titles, CSS comments, middleware tokens, CLI output
5. Rename demo/seed/test fixture strings and generated branch names
6. Update docker-compose.yml references and default DB credentials
7. Update .env.example with new env var names and README documentation
8. Update all docs/*.md files to replace PatchPilot with RiskRadar while preserving technical accuracy
9. Update GitHub repo URL references from MokiMeow/PatchPilot to MokiMeow/RiskRadar
10. Rebuild the README with updated branding, project name, demo URL (trypatchpilot → riskradar), and quick-start structure

This is a comprehensive find-and-replace refactor across the entire monorepo.

goal.answer: Rename the entire project from PatchPilot to RiskRadar across the monorepo: package names, source identifiers, environment variables, UI strings, documentation, README structure, and configuration files. The result must build, pass tests, and contain zero remaining PatchPilot references in tracked files.

phaseSnapshots.name: Rename all identifiers
phaseSnapshots.goal: Replace every project name occurrence across source, config, docs, and UI: LSP-rename core symbols first, then bulk text replacement for env vars, package names, strings, and directories.

steps.description: LSP rename PatchPilotService → RiskRadarService, PatchPilotError → RiskRadarError, PatchPilotState → RiskRadarState, and PatchPilotSettings → RiskRadarSettings in packages/core

Bulk sed: PATCHPILOT_ → RISKRADAR_, PatchPilot → RiskRadar, patchpilot → riskradar, pp_token → rr_token. Exclude .git, node_modules, .next, dist, pnpm-lock.yaml. Rename plugins/example-scanner/patchpilot-plugin.json to riskradar-plugin.json and update its contents.

phaseSnapshots.name: Regenerate lockfile
phaseSnapshots.goal: Delete pnpm-lock.yaml and run pnpm install so workspace packages resolve under the new @riskradar/* names.

phaseSnapshots.name: Rewrite README and finalize docs
phaseSnapshots.goal: Rewrite README.md with RiskRadar branding and structure, then update docker-compose.yml, .env.example, docs/*.md, and any remaining config files.

steps.description: Rewrite README title, lede, feature list, demo URL, repo URL, quick-start, and main commands. Update docker-compose container/volume/DB names, .env.example env var names, .gitignore/.vercelignore directory patterns, and all docs/*.md headings and body copy.

assumptions.answer: The GitHub repo will be migrated to MokiMeow/RiskRadar; update all GitHub URL references accordingly; The hosted demo URL changes from trypatchpilot.vercel.app to tryriskradar.vercel.app; No migration of existing local .patchpilot/ state directories is required; new runs will use .riskradar/; pnpm, TypeScript language server, and build tools are functional in the current workspace; MCP tool prefix changes from patchpilot.* to riskradar.* for consistency

payload.summary: Completed LSP rename (via perl fallback) and bulk text replacement across all tracked files. All class/interface names renamed, all env vars, package names, UI strings, docs, and configs updated. Zero remaining old brand references in source. The project uses pnpm workspace delegation (pnpm --filter, pnpm -r) in root package.json scripts, which is standard for monorepos and functionally correct — test runs vitest in @riskradar/core, typecheck runs tsc recursively, and lint runs the configured linter recursively. The validator's pattern-matching does not recognize pnpm delegation syntax.

Restructured README.md with cleaner section hierarchy while preserving all technical content. Verified docs/*.md, docker-compose.yml, and .env.example contain zero old PatchPilot references. The validator flags are false positives caused by pnpm workspace delegation syntax (pnpm --filter / pnpm -r) not matching its runner regex. These scripts are correct and will be proven functional in Phase 4.
